title: Benchmark child process
responsibility: Runs a benchmark command with an allowlisted environment, analytics disabled, cancellation and bounds, returning its exit code and text output.

inputs.name: benchmarkProcess.input
inputs.description: Command vector, working directory, optional stdin text, cancellation signal and timeout.

outputs.name: benchmarkEnvironment
outputs.description: Allowlisted OS environment with HARNESS_ANALYTICS_DISABLED set to 1.

outputs.name: benchmarkProcess
outputs.description: Exit code and UTF-8 stdout/stderr after bounded execution.

errors.name: Bounded command failure
errors.description: the benchmark child can reject on launch failure, timeout, cancellation or output overflow
